excerpts.author: jwasinger
excerpts.content: BALs should be persisted until WSP.  They will be served over devp2p for the purpose of speeding up snap sync healing phase.  However, the devp2p changes aren't included in devnet 2.  So technically ELs don't need to persist them to be compatible with devnet 2.
